models.description: Optional role → provider/model overrides (ADR-045). Unset roles fall back to top-level model. Do not set models.main.

subagent.description: Model for task tool child runs. Omit → main model.

compact.description: Model for session head compaction summaries. Omit → main model.

web.description: Model for task(kind=web) child runs. Omit → models.subagent then main.

vision.description: Auxiliary vision model for vision_analyze / video_analyze. Omit → tools not advertised.

speech.description: OpenAI-compatible Whisper model for audio_transcribe. Omit → tool not advertised.

id.description: Wire/API model id (OpenCode model.id). When omitted, the catalog key / selection model segment is sent upstream.

contextWindow.description: Model context length in tokens for packing/UI. Omit or 0 to fill from models.dev (or 1M default).

limit.description: OpenCode-style alias. Explicit contextWindow/maxTokens win when set.

chat.description: Session chat workspace. Tab agent=build (write) vs plan=read-only. allow_write is agent ceiling only.

workspace.description: Session workspace binding (ADR-046). Client cwd is default session root.

allow.description: Extra absolute roots always on the path ceiling

allow_all.description: Disable path-root containment (local single-user only; high risk)

allow_write.description: Ceiling for agent (build) write tools. Omit = true. Plan mode is always read-only.

tools.description: Opt-in high-risk tools for agent mode only (default all false). Plan never receives these.

git.description: Pre-authorize git_status/diff/add/commit under chat roots (agent only).

process.description: Pre-authorize process_exec under chat roots (agent only).

max_iterations.description: Agent tool-loop cap per turn (1–256). Omit or 0 = no hard cap (ADR-052).

permission.description: Remembered high-risk families (ADR-043). Auto is a TUI session stance, not a config mode. permission.mode is load-only compatibility and ignored at runtime.

mode.description: Accepted for old configs; ignored. Wait is TUI interactive; CLI/cron stay fail-closed.

allow.description: Remember process and/or git so Agent does not prompt. OR with chat.tools.*

memory.description: In-process layered memory (ADR-044). Omit = enabled defaults.

max_inject_runes.description: Cap frozen system memory inject block.

inject_mode.description: Frozen snapshot at session start; refresh via /refresh-memory.

default_ttl.description: Go duration applied to session/detail writes that omit expires_at (e.g. 168h). Empty or omit = no automatic expiry. Global curated never receives this TTL.

curator.description: H1-lite post-turn LLM fact extraction (uses models.compact when set).

enabled.description: Enable curator when memory is on. Omit = true.

max_facts.description: Max facts written per successful turn.

skills.description: H5-skill unused soft-archive (ADR-050). Omit = no automatic archive.

unused_ttl.description: Go duration; skills with last_used_at older than this are soft-archived (e.g. 720h). Empty or omit = no automatic archive. Never-used skills are not archived.

description.description: Short help for completer / list API

commands.description: User slash templates (O3). Keys are slash names without /. Instruction only — no grants. Injectscan at load.

web.description: Web search backend for web_search (Phase W). Omit = ddg. Not hot-reloaded.

search.description: Search backend. ddg needs no key. searxng requires searxng_url; tavily requires tavily_key.

searxng_url.description: SearXNG instance URL. Supports {env:VAR} / {file:…}. Required when search is searxng.

tavily_key.description: Tavily API key. Supports {env:VAR} / {file:…}. Required when search is tavily. Never logged.
